text: I understand that joining a group of people who already know each other can be intimidating. It's completely normal to feel awkward in such situations. If you're feeling nervous about attending another board-game evening, consider setting a small goal for yourself, such as introducing yourself to one person or asking someone to explain a game. This can help you feel more at ease and give you a sense of accomplishment. Afterward, you can decide whether the group is a good fit for you. Keep in mind that being quiet on your first visit doesn't necessarily mean you'll have a bad experience every time. It's okay to take things at your own pace and see how things go.
